audit-fixes: brief read, verifying claims and editing now; will report sha + gates here.

audit-fixes DONE: 239c601f on branch audit-fixes (one commit, 11 files).

Files: .agents/skills/ai-config-bootstrap/SKILL.md, bin/ai-setup, docs/session-context-fleet.md, lib/common.sh, skills/design-an-interface/SKILL.md, skills/improve-architecture/SKILL.md, skills/show-me/{SKILL,VENDOR}.md, skills/wayfinder/{SKILL,VENDOR}.md, new tools/herder/tests/check-ai-setup-missing-source.sh

Items:
1. wayfinder: changed. Removed the `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` pointer (line 25) and the Skill-tool calls to research/prototype (lines 77-78, 115), as in group A. VENDOR.md "Local changes" lists exactly those edits. The grilling/domain-modeling Skill calls stay because they resolve.
2. show-me: changed. `Bash(open …)` becomes the host opener (open/xdg-open), else the absolute path. VENDOR.md updated and the old dangling-dependency line dropped.
3. ai-config-bootstrap: changed. Verified that `--shell-path` does not exist (`--help`), that the default run calls mise_path_install and shell_rc_install (bin/ai-setup:251-252), and that the statusLine block is in claude/settings.shared.json. Steps 4-5 are replaced by a note on the default run plus `--rc`/`--shims status|remove`. The statusLine step now says to re-run instead of hand-merging. The rc-block rule is rewritten. Steps renumbered 1-6.
4. improve-architecture:93: changed. Handoff now writes the package to `<mission>/artifacts/improve-architecture/handoff-<cluster-name>.md`. Caveat: `~/.agents/skills/handoff` does exist on this host, but it is an unrelated GSD skill that writes continue.md, so the claim holds in substance.
5. design-an-interface:37: changed (the group B wording).
6. session-context-fleet Watchdogs bullet: changed, that bullet only. Verified hcom 0.7.25: `reqwatch` gives "Unknown command". The bullet now describes `hcom events sub [filters] [--once]` with `--idle`/`--blocked` and says hcom has no unanswered-request watcher.
7. codex link: changed, with a correction to the audit. install_link has ALWAYS skipped a missing source (since e332f728; it logged `INFO skip missing source`), so a full ai-setup would NOT have backed up ~/.codex/AGENTS.md or left a dangling link. What I did: removed the spec line, and raised the skip to `WARN skip link: repo source missing: <src> (left <dst> untouched)`, non-fatal. New check, temp HOME with stub mise/hcom: (a) against the real tree, a live ~/.codex/AGENTS.md survives dry-run and a full run untouched, with no backup and no mention in the output; (b) against a repo copy with two sources deleted, in dry-run, full and --heal-only modes: warns, completes, leaves an existing target untouched with no backup, and creates no absent target. Red against the old code: 6 FAILs without the WARN change, 2 FAILs without the spec removal.

Gates (all run by me):
- check-ai-setup-codex-config.sh: 57 PASS, rc 0
- check-ai-setup-hcom-notes.sh: 3 PASS, rc 0
- check-ai-setup-missing-source.sh (new): 27 PASS, rc 0
- shellcheck 0.11.0: new test clean; `shellcheck -x bin/ai-setup` clean; lib/common.sh has 2 SC2034 (PUSH_PATHS, PORTABLE_SCAN_PATHS unused), identical count on HEAD~ (pre-existing)
- `bin/ai-setup --dry-run`, temp HOME: rc 0, 0 mentions of AGENTS.md, nothing written to HOME

Decision for you (not in scope, left alone): three other portable specs also have missing repo sources: claude/CLAUDE.md, claude/commands, cursor/rules. They now print 3 WARN lines on every ai-setup run; before, these were quiet INFO lines. Remove those specs in a follow-up, or keep the warnings as a to-do? Also, `codex/AGENTS.md` still appears in lib/common.sh PUSH_PATHS, PORTABLE_SCAN_PATHS and the line-226 case. That is harmless, and I left it because the brief said the spec line only.

# audit-fixes final review

**APPROVE** — `dfe4dc5f16e101a9c87003176eda205a9b2d4df1`.

1. Previous finding 1 is resolved. `docs/session-context-fleet.md:45` now correctly describes idle and blocked notifications and explicitly directs the subscriber to check whether the requested report arrived before following up. This matches the installed hcom 0.7.25 help captured in `hcom-events-help.log`.
2. No outstanding findings. The entire delta from reviewed `110f33ee` is this one documentation line (one insertion, one deletion), verified from git and archived privately. The earlier review and its 88 passing installer assertions remain applicable; no shell code changed, so those tests were not repeated. The two baseline SC2034 warnings remain the previously documented limitation.

This final verdict supersedes the REQUEST-CHANGES verdict in `review.md`; that report and its evidence remain as the review record. See `recheck.diff` for the complete follow-up change.
